# Slider (`slider`)

Single value slider, horizontal or vertical, with marks.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSlider` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/slider.d.ts`): `.mh-slider`: a styled native `<input type="range">` (arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End and touch come from the platform), with an optional label, value readout and marks. The fill is drawn from `--_at`.

```ts
export function createSlider(options: SliderOptions): SliderHandle;

export interface SliderOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  value?: number;
  /** Shows the current value beside the label. */
  showValue?: boolean;
  /** Formats the shown value and the spoken `aria-valuetext` (e.g. `v => v + '%'`). */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Labelled positions under the track. */
  marks?: readonly SliderMark[];
  name?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** While dragging. */
  onInput?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
  /** When the value is committed. */
  onChange?: (value: number, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SliderHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSlider } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const brightness = createSlider({
  label: 'Brightness',
  value: 60,
  step: 5,
  showValue: true,
  format: (v) => `${v}%`,
  // onInput fires while dragging; onChange once the thumb is let go.
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Kitchen lights set to ${value}%`),
});

document.body.append(brightness.el, status);
```

export function Slider({ label, min = 0, max = 100, step = 1, value, defaultValue, showValue, format, marks, onValueChange, onChange, className, id, ...rest }: SliderProps);

export interface SliderProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'min' | 'max' | 'step'> {
  label?: ReactNode;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  value?: number;
  defaultValue?: number;

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SliderExample() {
  const [brightness, setBrightness] = useState(60);
  return (
    <Slider
      label="Brightness"
      step={5}
      showValue
      format={(v) => `${v}%`}
      value={brightness}
      onValueChange={setBrightness}
    />
  );
}
```
